scalars.scalar_value: Experience with virtual care workflow optimizations, inpatient clinical workflows, or inpatient clinical background.

items.item_text: Formal project management certification (PMP).
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Nine (9) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus five (5) years of related experience/training.
Experience with virtual care workflow optimizations, inpatient clinical workflows, or inpatient clinical background.
Experience developing and delivering training on the workflows.
Experience within a large, complex healthcare system or academic medical center.
Experience with workflow redesign, governance, KPI/measurement development, risk and dependency management, and organizational change.

The Organizational Consultant 4 will serve as the primary project manager for UC San Diego Health’s expanding virtual care strategy, leading the development, implementation, and optimization of workflows across ambulatory and inpatient telehealth, e-Consults, virtual care teams, and remote monitoring. The role will have enterprise-wide impact, partnering with clinical, operational, IT, and support services leaders to design workflows, establish standards and operating models, facilitate training and adoption, and drive continuous improvement. The position independently leads complex, multi-department initiatives with limited day-to-day direction and is accountable for translating enterprise virtual care strategy into scalable operating models, governance, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes. The role manages multiple concurrent workstreams and serves as a strategic project and organizational consulting partner to senior, physician, operational, and technical leaders.
Proficiency with project, portfolio, analytics, and operational management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Wrike, Asana, Visio, Power BI, Tableau, Jira, or similar platforms).
Advanced knowledge of the organizational development and effectiveness field, theories, models to assess, design and implement customized, strategic organization interventions.
Lean Six Sigma knowledge/skills.
Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, project planning and implementation skills.
Change management knowledge/skills.
Highly skilled in facilitation, consulting and relationship building.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead large-scale, complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Applies strong verbal, written communication and presentation skills.
Advanced project/program planning and implementation skills.
Possesses strong consulting, relationship building, and strategic thinking skills.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
Demonstrates skill consulting to managers and groups at all levels.
Executive-level facilitation, consultation, and presentation skills.
Ability to coach, facilitate and influence people at all levels.
Ability to influence and build alignment across clinical, operational, technical, and leadership stakeholders.
Demonstrates ability to learn quickly, reason, synthesize and generalize based on information obtained; sound judgment; ability to draw unbiased conclusions.
Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where precedent or standard solutions may not exist.
Ability to focus on priorities, strategies, and vision.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and drive measurable outcomes.
Knowledge of the consulting process to effectively lead engagements from inception to conclusion.
Ability to persuade through both logic and appeal to positive motivations.
